by the bidder as a price component of the total price quoted in his bid and if any new taxes, duties & levies become applicable after the bid opening shall be to POWERGRID account and shall be reimbursed to the bidder or returne d by him as the case may be. All the payment shall be released to the Contractor directly. All payments to be made directly to the Contractor shall be made by the Em ployer though electronic payment mechanism (e-payment) for which necess ary details shall be tied up during execution of the Contract. POWERGRID’s GSTIN number in each state/UT is published on the POWERGR ID’s company website https://www.powergridindia.com. nd liabilities under the Contract. No bonus will be given for earlier completi on of the delivery of Goods. 13. Payment Transaction reference number shall be submitted to POWERG RID for verification. Performance security in favor of POWERGRID can also be submitted as o nline payment through POWERGRID ONLINE PAYMENT UTILITY- https://ep ay.powergrid.in, a link of which is provided on the POWERGRID website www.powergrid.in. This deduction shall be continued till the total amount towards Security Deposit reaches five percent (05%) of the Contr act Price. 14.5 Contractor shall be entitled for reduction of performance security correspon ding to 10% of the contract price of the part of facility whose defect liability p eriod has been extended if any. 14.6 For every increase in contract price exceeding 10% of the contract price as o riginally set forth in LOA, performance security shall be increased correspondi ng to the revised contract price.
